operation: mean-ablation: each node's write is replaced, at every token position, by its mean over the prompt bank

facts.operation_note: whole layer = every head slice plus the MLP; the residual stream still carries mean writes, so this is not block deletion

prompts: The largest planet in the solar system is
She poured the coffee into the
The president of the United States in 2020 was
A dog is a kind of
If it rains, the ground gets

travel.metric: relative L2 change in the residual stream at the final token position, versus the clean run
